title: Joseph Lebel appeared on ONNJ Mornings with Ken Rosato
summary: OceanFirst Bank President and COO Joseph Lebel talks with ONNJ Mornings with Ken Rosato
body_markdown:
OceanFirst Bank President & Chief Operating Officer Joseph Lebel discusses New Jersey’s summer economy and OceanFirst Bank’s expansion.


Watch the interview below or to watch the entire episode,[click here](https://www.onnj.com/videos/onnj-mornings-with-ken-rosato-wednesday-july-8-2026/) .
